_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

itemName.description: Display value of itemId, copied from u_mes_prod_item.description

productVariantName.description: Display value of productVariantId, copied from u_mes_prod_productVariant.name

billOfMaterialName.description: Display value of billOfMaterialId, copied from u_mes_prod_billOfMaterial.recordNo

routingName.description: Display value of routingId, copied from u_mes_prod_routing.description

lineName.description: Display value of lineId, copied from u_mes_mast_line.name

customerScheduleName.description: Display value of customerScheduleId, copied from u_mes_plan_customerSchedule.recordNo

unitOfMeasureName.description: Display value of unitOfMeasureId, copied from u_mes_mast_unitOfMeasure.name

plannedStartAt.description: Planned start date and time. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

plannedEndAt.description: Planned end date and time. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

actualStartAt.description: Actual start date and time. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

actualEndAt.description: Actual end date and time. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

dueDate.description: Due date. Date field: calendar date only, stored as 00:00:00 of that day in local plant time (IST) with the +0000 suffix

erpMessageName.description: Display value of erpMessageId, copied from u_mes_syst_erpMessage.recordNo

closedAt.description: Date and time when the record was closed. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

closedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'closed'

closedBy.description: Display name of the user in closedById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

onHold.description: True while the order is on hold

qualityHoldName.description: Display value of qualityHoldId, copied from u_mes_qual_qualityHold.recordNo

holdReasonCodeId.description: Reference to u_mes_perf_reasonCode._id: hold reason code

holdReasonCodeName.description: Display value of holdReasonCodeId, copied from u_mes_perf_reasonCode.name

genealogyComplete.description: True when every unit of the order has complete component genealogy (closure check)

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName
